title: Addendum 1 to PREREG_TEST_V2 (before the TEST is opened)
test_status_at_registration: NOT OPENED: no TEST outcome, table or study file has been read by V2 code

1_test_dataset_builder.principle: imports the frozen s03_build_dataset.py and x01_stress_recovery.py unchanged; only the input database and output folder are redirected

2_test_specific_rules.year_window: the TRAIN rule 'year > 2023 excluded' is replaced by 'year < 2024 excluded' (TEST window)
2_test_specific_rules.study_specific_train_decisions: value corrections, relative-unit inclusions and study exclusions of the TRAIN register name TRAIN studies only and do not apply to TEST
2_test_specific_rules.unit_unresolved_test_contrasts: excluded from TEST_PRIMARY (no study-level review is allowed after opening TEST); counted and reported
2_test_specific_rules.generic_rules_applied: yield tiers, one contrast per SB/S arm pair (terminal cumulative total), synthetic-PGR exclusion, box-centre / dry / non-marketable routing

3_confirmatory_TRAIN_meta_analysis_R.method: metafor::rma.mv REML, random ~1|study/contrast; clubSandwich CR2 by study (Satterthwaite df)

4_secondary_TEST_meta_analyses.script: src/s17_test_meta.py (runs only after the one-time s13 evaluation)
analyses: TRAIN vs TEST difference (dataset moderator, CR2)
4_secondary_TEST_meta_analyses.interpretation: consistency if the 95% CR2 CI of the TEST-minus-TRAIN difference includes 0; the TEST pooled mean is also compared with the TRAIN 95% prediction interval for a new study's mean (-0.43 to 1.52). Secondary only: never changes the primary verdicts of PREREG_TEST_V2

5_chronology_and_blinding.test_extraction_frozen_against: V1 MODEL_FREEZE (pipeline.yaml model_freeze_path of the TEST project)
5_chronology_and_blinding.statement: The TEST extraction started under the V1 freeze. V2 (data audit, models, intervals, conditional models) was developed afterwards without access to any TEST data: only the TEST project's task-state counts were looked at. The TEST therefore remains independent of V2. The TEST project configuration is not changed.
